sonnet.problem: The true/false statement tests two claims at once: that Jesus asks for the cup to pass, and that He says His own will should come first. Only the second part is false.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The story card says "none of tonight is random," which adds a time of day. Verses 26:36-56 give no time, so "tonight" is not in the text.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
